content.text:
Two wake-ups at 19 months usually means Remy hasn't learned to resettle independently, so when a sleep cycle ends he calls for you instead of drifting back. Try a consistent bedtime wind-down and, when he wakes, wait 2-3 minutes before going in so he gets a chance to settle himself first.

Want the full night-by-night plan for Remy? Reply YES and I'll send it.
